import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Load datasets
no2_df = pd.read_csv('chunks_csv/moran_global_no2crime_no2_Q3_2023.csv')
adj_df = pd.read_csv('chunks_csv/borough_adjacency.csv')

# 1. Listwise deletion: retain only boroughs with complete NO2 observations
no2_clean = no2_df.dropna(subset=['value']).copy()
retained_boroughs = no2_clean['borough'].tolist()
n = len(retained_boroughs)

# 2. Build binary spatial weights matrix for retained boroughs
retained_set = set(retained_boroughs)
borough_to_idx = {b: i for i, b in enumerate(retained_boroughs)}

# Keep only adjacency pairs where both boroughs are retained
adj_filtered = adj_df[
    adj_df['borough'].isin(retained_set) & adj_df['neighbor'].isin(retained_set)
].copy()

# Symmetrize and deduplicate edges (undirected neighbor relations)
edges = set()
for _, row in adj_filtered.iterrows():
    b1, b2 = row['borough'], row['neighbor']
    if b1 != b2:
        edges.add(frozenset({b1, b2}))

W_binary = np.zeros((n, n))
for edge in edges:
    b1, b2 = tuple(edge)
    i, j = borough_to_idx[b1], borough_to_idx[b2]
    W_binary[i, j] = 1.0
    W_binary[j, i] = 1.0

# Iteratively drop any isolates (boroughs with no neighbors among the retained set)
while True:
    row_sums = W_binary.sum(axis=1)
    isolates = np.where(row_sums == 0)[0]
    if len(isolates) == 0:
        break
    mask = np.ones(W_binary.shape[0], dtype=bool)
    mask[isolates] = False
    W_binary = W_binary[mask][:, mask]
    no2_clean = no2_clean.iloc[mask].copy()
    retained_boroughs = no2_clean['borough'].tolist()
    borough_to_idx = {b: i for i, b in enumerate(retained_boroughs)}
    n = len(retained_boroughs)
    row_sums = W_binary.sum(axis=1)

# Row-standardize so that every row sums to 1
W = W_binary / row_sums[:, np.newaxis]

# 3. Compute observed Global Moran's I
z = no2_clean['value'].values
z = z - z.mean()
I_obs = (z @ W @ z) / (z @ z)

# 4. Permutation-based significance test (999 random shuffles)
np.random.seed(42)
n_perm = 999
I_perm = np.empty(n_perm)

for i in range(n_perm):
    z_perm = np.random.permutation(z)
    I_perm[i] = (z_perm @ W @ z_perm) / (z_perm @ z_perm)

# Two-tailed p-value: proportion of permuted |I| at least as large as observed |I|
p_value = np.mean(np.abs(I_perm) >= np.abs(I_obs))

# 5. Print required outputs
data_points_used = n
verdict = "CLUSTERED" if I_obs > 0 and p_value < 0.05 else "NOT CLUSTERED"
method_name = "Global Moran's I"

print(f"data_points_used = {data_points_used}")
print(f"FINAL ANSWER: {verdict} (test statistic = {I_obs}, significance measure = {p_value})")
